name: South Sudan

fees.name: South Sudan Visa (Embassy-issued, single entry, standard nationalities)
fees.applies: Rest of Africa, Asia, Gulf countries, Canadian, European nationals
fees.notes: Fee schedule published by the Embassy of South Sudan in Washington DC; issued within ten business days (stated as a temporary measure). Fees may vary slightly by issuing embassy/consulate.

fees.name: South Sudan Visa - bordering African countries
fees.applies: Nationals of African countries bordering South Sudan

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (search by country on official portal)
fees.notes: Official e-visa portal (evisa.gov.ss) charges fees that vary by nationality and visa type (single entry / 3-month multiple entry / 6-month multiple entry). The exact amounts are not published in static page content and require searching by country on the portal; could not verify a specific figure from an official source, so amount is left null rather than guessed. Standard single-entry fee is USD 100 per the per-country eligibility results recorded in visa-policy notes; see separate entries for multiple-entry, reduced-rate and US-national tiers.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa - 3-month multiple entry (standard)
fees.notes: Standard 3-month multiple-entry fee per the official eligibility table.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa - 6-month multiple entry (standard)
fees.notes: Standard 6-month multiple-entry fee per the official eligibility table.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa - single entry (reduced rate)
fees.notes: Reduced-rate tier shown for some nationalities (e.g. Sudan, DR Congo, Central African Republic) on the official eligibility table; EAC nationals' visa-policy notes also cite USD 50 single entry online.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa - 3-month multiple entry (reduced rate)
fees.notes: Reduced-rate tier shown for some nationalities (e.g. Sudan, DR Congo, Central African Republic) on the official eligibility table.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa - 6-month multiple entry (reduced rate)
fees.notes: Reduced-rate tier shown for some nationalities (e.g. Sudan, DR Congo, Central African Republic) on the official eligibility table.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa - single entry (US nationals)
fees.notes: US nationals pay USD 160 for single entry per the official eligibility table.

fees.name: South Sudan e-Visa - 3-month multiple entry (US nationals)
fees.notes: US nationals pay USD 500 for 3-month multiple entry; 6-month multiple entry not available to US nationals per the official eligibility table.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival at Juba International Airport - EAC member states (free)
fees.notes: Free (USD 0) visa on arrival for EAC member state nationals (Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi) per Embassy of South Sudan in Uganda and Embassy DC (ssembassydc.org) sources.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival at Juba International Airport
fees.applies: Nationals of Rwanda and Burundi (limited eligibility); reported informally as similar in range to embassy visa fees for other eligible nationals
fees.notes: No official government source with a confirmed VOA fee amount was found; third-party sources cite figures around USD 100 (USD 160 for US passport holders) but these are not confirmed on an official government page, so amount is left null. Payable in cash USD at the airport per third-party reporting.

reciprocity_variations.note: US passport holders charged USD 160 per Embassy of South Sudan (Washington DC) published fee schedule.
Rest of Africa, Asia, Gulf countries, Canadian, and European nationals charged USD 100 per Embassy of South Sudan published fee schedule. NGA falls under 'rest of Africa' (non-bordering).

free_visa_notes: East African Community (EAC) member state nationals and Egyptian nationals travel visa-free per the Embassy of South Sudan's published schedule. Diplomatic/official passport holders are exempt (gratis).
